description: This file implements an image proxy backend for Mattermost, handling image retrieval, content type detection, and security headers.

classes.name: LocalBackend
classes.description: Handles local image proxy requests, including fetching images and serving them with security headers.

classes.name: URLError
classes.description: Represents a malformed URL error in the proxy.

classes.name: contentTypeRecorder
classes.description: Wraps an http.ResponseWriter to record and modify Content-Type headers.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Sets Content-Disposition header based on Content-Type and filename.

methods.name: GetImage
methods.description: Fetches an image from a URL and writes it to the ResponseWriter with security headers.

methods.name: GetImageDirect
methods.description: Fetches an image directly as a stream.

methods.name: ServeImage
methods.description: Proxies an image request, adding security headers and handling content type validation.

methods.name: copyHeader
methods.description: Copies specified headers from source to destination.

methods.name: should304
methods.description: Determines if the response can be a 304 Not Modified based on headers.

methods.name: peekContentType
methods.description: Detects content type by peeking at the first bytes of a buffer.

methods.name: contentTypeMatches
methods.description: Checks if a content type matches allowed patterns.

methods.name: newProxyRequest
methods.description: Creates a proxyRequest object from an HTTP request.

methods.name: parseURL
methods.description: Parses a URL string, fixing common URL munging issues.
